bio: First things first: be sure to book, because the Bouvier family's small restaurant has just four tables (hence the name BOU4). Junior manager and maître d' Julian Bouvier attentively hosts a maximum of 14 diners. Chef Christoph Gschwendtner also joins in front of house, proud to personally present his creations at the table. His cooking leans towards classic French cuisine, with Asian or Levantine accents adding variety. The dishes are elaborate and technical, as you will see from the get-go with the array of appetisers. Diners can opt for a four- or six-course format of the set menu, the dishes in which change weekly. The meal starts for all diners at 6pm.
